translations.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,
translations.ylt: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ, through the will of God, according to a promise of life that is in Christ Jesus,
translations.web: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,

translations.kjv: To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
translations.ylt: to Timotheus, beloved child: Grace, kindness, peace, from God the Father, and Christ Jesus our Lord!
translations.web: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

translations.kjv: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;
translations.ylt: I am thankful to God, whom I serve from progenitors in a pure conscience, that unceasingly I have remembrance concerning thee in my supplications night and day,
translations.web: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day

translations.kjv: Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;
translations.ylt: desiring greatly to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that with joy I may be filled,
translations.web: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;

translations.kjv: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.
translations.ylt: taking remembrance of the unfeigned faith that is in thee, that dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice, and I am persuaded that also in thee.
translations.web: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, in you also.

translations.kjv: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.
translations.ylt: For which cause I remind thee to stir up the gift of God that is in thee through the putting on of my hands,
translations.web: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

translations.kjv: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
translations.ylt: for God did not give us a spirit of fear, but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind;
translations.web: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

translations.kjv: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;
translations.ylt: therefore thou mayest not be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner, but do thou suffer evil along with the good news according to the power of God,
translations.web: Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,

translations.kjv: Who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,
translations.ylt: who did save us, and did call with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to His own purpose and grace, that was given to us in Christ Jesus, before the times of the ages,
translations.web: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,

translations.kjv: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:
translations.ylt: and was made manifest now through the manifestation of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who indeed did abolish death, and did enlighten life and immortality through the good news,
translations.web: but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the Good News.

translations.kjv: Whereunto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
translations.ylt: to which I was placed a preacher and an apostle, and a teacher of nations,
translations.web: For this I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

translations.kjv: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.
translations.ylt: for which cause also these things I suffer, but I am not ashamed, for I have known in whom I have believed, and have been persuaded that he is able that which I have committed to him to guard--to that day.
translations.web: For this cause I also suffer these things. Yet I am not ashamed, for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed to him against that day.

translations.kjv: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
translations.ylt: The pattern hold thou of sound words, which from me thou didst hear, in faith and love that is in Christ Jesus;
translations.web: Hold the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

translations.kjv: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us.
translations.ylt: the good thing committed guard thou through the Holy Spirit that is dwelling in us;
translations.web: That good thing which was committed to you, guard through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.

translations.kjv: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.
translations.ylt: thou hast known this, that they did turn from me--all those in Asia, of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes;
translations.web: This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.

translations.kjv: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:
translations.ylt: may the Lord give kindness to the house of Onesiphorus, because many times he did refresh me, and of my chain was not ashamed,
translations.web: May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain,

translations.kjv: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.
translations.ylt: but being in Rome, very diligently he sought me, and found;
translations.web: but when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently and found me

translations.kjv: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.
translations.ylt: may the Lord give to him to find kindness from the Lord in that day; and how many things in Ephesus he did minister thou dost very well know.
translations.web: (the Lord grant to him to find the Lord’s mercy in that day); and in how many things he served at Ephesus, you know very well.

translations.kjv: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
translations.ylt: Thou, therefore, my child, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus,
translations.web: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

translations.kjv: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.
translations.ylt: and the things that thou didst hear from me through many witnesses, these things be committing to stedfast men, who shall be sufficient also others to teach;
translations.web: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.

translations.kjv: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
translations.ylt: thou, therefore, suffer evil as a good soldier of Jesus Christ;
translations.web: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

translations.kjv: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.
translations.ylt: no one serving as a soldier did entangle himself with the affairs of life, that him who did enlist him he may please;
translations.web: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.

translations.kjv: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.
translations.ylt: and if also any one may strive, he is not crowned, except he may strive lawfully;
translations.web: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn’t crowned unless he has competed by the rules.

translations.kjv: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.
translations.ylt: the labouring husbandman it behoveth first of the fruits to partake;
translations.web: The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.

translations.kjv: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.
translations.ylt: be considering what things I say, for the Lord give to thee understanding in all things.
translations.web: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.

translations.kjv: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:
translations.ylt: Remember Jesus Christ, raised out of the dead, of the seed of David, according to my good news,
translations.web: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the offspring of David, according to my Good News,

translations.kjv: Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.
translations.ylt: in which I suffer evil--unto bonds, as an evil-doer, but the word of God hath not been bound;
translations.web: in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.

translations.kjv: Therefore I endure all things for the elect’s sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
translations.ylt: because of this all things do I endure, because of the choice ones, that they also salvation may obtain that is in Christ Jesus, with glory age-during.
translations.web: Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

translations.kjv: It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:
translations.ylt: Stedfast is the word: For if we died together--we also shall live together;
translations.web: This saying is trustworthy: “For if we died with him, we will also live with him.

translations.kjv: If we suffer, we shall also reign with him: if we deny him, he also will deny us:
translations.ylt: if we do endure together--we shall also reign together; if we deny him, he also shall deny us;
translations.web: If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.

translations.kjv: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.
translations.ylt: if we are not stedfast, he remaineth stedfast; to deny himself he is not able.
translations.web: If we are faithless, he remains faithful; for he can’t deny himself.”

translations.kjv: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.
translations.ylt: These things remind them of, testifying fully before the Lord--not to strive about words to nothing profitable, but to the subversion of those hearing;
translations.web: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord that they don’t argue about words to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.

translations.kjv: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
translations.ylt: be diligent to present thyself approved to God--a workman irreproachable, rightly dividing the word of the truth;
translations.web: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.

translations.kjv: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.
translations.ylt: and the profane vain talkings stand aloof from, for to more impiety they will advance,
translations.web: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,

translations.kjv: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymeneus and Philetus;
translations.ylt: and their word as a gangrene will have pasture, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus,
translations.web: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:

translations.kjv: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.
translations.ylt: who concerning the truth did swerve, saying the rising again to have already been, and do overthrow the faith of some;
translations.web: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.

translations.kjv: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.
translations.ylt: sure, nevertheless, hath the foundation of God stood, having this seal, `The Lord hath known those who are His,' and `Let him depart from unrighteousness--every one who is naming the name of Christ.'
translations.web: However, God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”

translations.kjv: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.
translations.ylt: And in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth, and some to honour, and some to dishonour:
translations.web: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for honor and some for dishonor.

translations.kjv: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master’s use, and prepared unto every good work.
translations.ylt: if, then, any one may cleanse himself from these, he shall be a vessel to honour, sanctified and profitable to the master--to every good work having been prepared,
translations.web: If anyone therefore purges himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified, and suitable for the master’s use, prepared for every good work.

translations.kjv: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
translations.ylt: and the youthful lusts flee thou, and pursue righteousness, faith, love, peace, with those calling upon the Lord out of a pure heart;
translations.web: Flee from youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

translations.kjv: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.
translations.ylt: and the foolish and uninstructed questions be avoiding, having known that they beget strife,
translations.web: But refuse foolish and ignorant questionings, knowing that they generate strife.

translations.kjv: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,
translations.ylt: and a servant of the Lord it behoveth not to strive, but to be gentle unto all, apt to teach, patient under evil,
translations.web: The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient,

translations.kjv: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;
translations.ylt: in meekness instructing those opposing--if perhaps God may give to them repentance to an acknowledging of the truth,
translations.web: in gentleness correcting those who oppose him. Perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth,

translations.kjv: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.
translations.ylt: and they may awake out of the devil's snare, having been caught by him at his will.
translations.web: and they may recover themselves out of the devil’s snare, having been taken captive by him to do his will.

translations.kjv: This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.
translations.ylt: And this know thou, that in the last days there shall come perilous times,
translations.web: But know this: that in the last days, grievous times will come.

translations.kjv: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
translations.ylt: for men shall be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boasters, proud, evil-speakers, to parents disobedient, unthankful, unkind,
translations.web: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

translations.kjv: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,
translations.ylt: without natural affection, implacable, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, not lovers of those who are good,
translations.web: without natural affection, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, not lovers of good,

translations.kjv: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;
translations.ylt: traitors, heady, lofty, lovers of pleasure more than lovers of God,
translations.web: traitors, headstrong, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,

translations.kjv: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.
translations.ylt: having a form of piety, and its power having denied; and from these be turning away,
translations.web: holding a form of godliness but having denied its power. Turn away from these, also.

translations.kjv: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,
translations.ylt: for of these there are those coming into the houses and leading captive the silly women, laden with sins, led away with desires manifold,
translations.web: For some of these are people who creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,

translations.kjv: Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
translations.ylt: always learning, and never to a knowledge of truth able to come,
translations.web: always learning and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

translations.kjv: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.
translations.ylt: and, even as Jannes and Jambres stood against Moses, so also these do stand against the truth, men corrupted in mind, disapproved concerning the faith;
translations.web: Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these also oppose the truth, men corrupted in mind, who concerning the faith are rejected.

translations.kjv: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all men, as theirs also was.
translations.ylt: but they shall not advance any further, for their folly shall be manifest to all, as theirs also did become.
translations.web: But they will proceed no further. For their folly will be evident to all men, as theirs also came to be.

translations.kjv: But thou hast fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,
translations.ylt: And thou--thou hast followed after my teaching, manner of life, purpose, faith, long-suffering, love, endurance,
translations.web: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,

translations.kjv: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.
translations.ylt: the persecutions, the afflictions, that befell me in Antioch, in Iconium, in Lystra; what persecutions I endured, and out of all the Lord did deliver me,
translations.web: persecutions, and sufferings—those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.

translations.kjv: Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.
translations.ylt: and all also who will to live piously in Christ Jesus shall be persecuted,
translations.web: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.

translations.kjv: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.
translations.ylt: and evil men and impostors shall advance to the worse, leading astray and being led astray.
translations.web: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

translations.kjv: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them;
translations.ylt: And thou--be remaining in the things which thou didst learn and wast entrusted with, having known from whom thou didst learn,
translations.web: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.

translations.kjv: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
translations.ylt: and because from a babe the Holy Writings thou hast known, which are able to make thee wise--to salvation, through faith that is in Christ Jesus;
translations.web: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

translations.kjv: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
translations.ylt: every Writing is God-breathed, and profitable for teaching, for conviction, for setting aright, for instruction that is in righteousness,
translations.web: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,

translations.kjv: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.
translations.ylt: that the man of God may be fitted--for every good work having been completed.
translations.web: that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.

translations.kjv: I charge thee therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;
translations.ylt: I do fully testify, then, before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who is about to judge living and dead at his manifestation and his reign--
translations.web: I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:

translations.kjv: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.
translations.ylt: preach the word; be earnest in season, out of season, convict, rebuke, exhort, in all long-suffering and teaching,
translations.web: preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.

translations.kjv: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;
translations.ylt: for there shall be a season when the sound teaching they will not suffer, but according to their own desires to themselves they shall heap up teachers--itching in the hearing,
translations.web: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts,

translations.kjv: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.
translations.ylt: and indeed, from the truth the hearing they shall turn away, and to the fables they shall be turned aside.
translations.web: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.

translations.kjv: But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.
translations.ylt: And thou--watch in all things; suffer evil; do the work of one proclaiming good news; of thy ministration make full assurance,
translations.web: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.

translations.kjv: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.
translations.ylt: for I am already being poured out, and the time of my release hath arrived;
translations.web: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.

translations.kjv: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
translations.ylt: the good strife I have striven, the course I have finished, the faith I have kept,
translations.web: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.

translations.kjv: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
translations.ylt: henceforth there is laid up for me the crown of the righteousness that the Lord--the Righteous Judge--shall give to me in that day, and not only to me, but also to all those loving his manifestation.
translations.web: From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.

translations.kjv: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me:
translations.ylt: Be diligent to come unto me quickly,
translations.web: Be diligent to come to me soon,

translations.kjv: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.
translations.ylt: for Demas forsook me, having loved the present age, and went on to Thessalonica, Crescens to Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia,
translations.web: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to Dalmatia.

translations.kjv: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.
translations.ylt: Lukas only is with me; Markus having taken, bring with thyself, for he is profitable to me for ministration;
translations.web: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.

translations.kjv: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.
translations.ylt: and Tychicus I sent to Ephesus;
translations.web: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

translations.kjv: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but especially the parchments.
translations.ylt: the cloak that I left in Troas with Carpus, coming, bring thou and the books--especially the parchments.
translations.web: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come—and the books, especially the parchments.

translations.kjv: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:
translations.ylt: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil; may the Lord repay to him according to his works,
translations.web: Alexander the coppersmith did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.

translations.kjv: Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.
translations.ylt: of whom also do thou beware, for greatly hath he stood against our words;
translations.web: Beware of him, for he greatly opposed our words.

translations.kjv: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.
translations.ylt: in my first defence no one stood with me, but all forsook me, (may it not be reckoned to them!)
translations.web: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.

translations.kjv: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
translations.ylt: and the Lord stood by me, and did strengthen me, that through me the preaching might be fully assured, and all the nations might hear, and I was freed out of the mouth of a lion,
translations.web: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

translations.kjv: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
translations.ylt: and the Lord shall free me from every evil work, and shall save me --to his heavenly kingdom; to whom is the glory to the ages of the ages! Amen.
translations.web: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

translations.kjv: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
translations.ylt: Salute Prisca and Aquilas, and Onesiphorus' household;
translations.web: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.

translations.kjv: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.
translations.ylt: Erastus did remain in Corinth, and Trophimus I left in Miletus infirm;
translations.web: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.

translations.kjv: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
translations.ylt: be diligent to come before winter. Salute thee doth Eubulus, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
translations.web: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.

translations.kjv: The Lord Jesus Christ be with thy spirit. Grace be with you. Amen. The second epistle unto Timotheus, ordained the first bishop of the church of the Ephesians, was written from Rome, when Paul was brought before Nero the second time.
translations.ylt: The Lord Jesus Christ is with thy spirit; the grace is with you! Amen.
translations.web: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
